from enum import Enum
from typing import cast

from ember_py import Client
from ember_py.condened_element import CondensedMatrix




[docs]
class Matrix:
    _client: Client

    _base_path = "1.3.1"

    def __init__(self, client: Client, base_path: str | None = None):
        self._client = client
        if base_path is not None:
            self._base_path = base_path



[docs]
    async def connect(self, source: Enum | int, target: Enum | int):
        """connect() expects source and target from an enum

        example:
            class Foo(Enum):
                Source01 = 1650
                Target01 = 1630

            matrix.connect(Foo.Source01, Foo.Target01)
        """
        s_val = source.value if isinstance(source, Enum) else source
        t_val = target.value if isinstance(target, Enum) else target

        await self._client.set(
            self._base_path,
            f"{s_val}>{t_val}",
            ignore_already_set=True,
            # skip_response=True,
        )



    @property
    async def ember_matrix(self) -> CondensedMatrix:
        return cast(CondensedMatrix, await self._client.get(self._base_path))
